name: CJ Affiliate
description: CJ Affiliate is an affiliate-marketing network for advertisers and publishers, including programs, relationships, promotional links, products, commissions, actions, tracking, and data feeds.
agentUseSummary: CJ Affiliate cannot yet be connected through Relay. CJ APIs use a user-generated Personal Access Token as a bearer credential without published granular scopes, while API availability and authority differ across publisher, advertiser, and technical-partner products; a representative publisher token, Website ID, role, and lifecycle contract is required first.

providerSetup.blocker: CJ users create Personal Access Tokens while logged into the Developer Portal and send them as bearer credentials. CJ publishes no granular PAT scopes and separates publisher-only APIs from advertiser tracking, data imports, technical-partner APIs, and product-specific entitlements; Relay has no representative publisher proving exact account role, Website ID, relationships, available APIs, or token lifecycle.
providerSetup.nextAction: The exclusive provider-console and production-acceptance task should obtain authorization from a representative CJ publisher, create a dedicated Personal Access Token without exposing it in reports, bind the exact Website ID, store the token in Railway, and return publisher-role, property and advertiser-relationship binding, rotation and revocation, API entitlement, schemas, quotas, financial and personal-data redaction, denial, and disconnect evidence before implementation.

evidence.supports: CJ documents Personal Access Tokens supplied through HTTPS bearer authentication and deprecates legacy developer keys for future APIs.
CJ requires an authenticated user to create and manage account-bound Personal Access Tokens and warns that they must remain private.

CJ's publisher-only Link Search API requires the bearer token plus an exact Website ID and exposes joined and unjoined advertiser relationships, promotional links, commission terms, and tracking code at a 25-call-per-minute limit.

CJ publishes separate publisher, advertiser, data-import, tracking, product-feed, and technical-partner products and requires a CJ Technical Integration Engineer for advertiser API tracking integration.
